title: lsp: syntax-only requests (documentSymbol, foldingRange, …) are blocked behind Corsa work on the single-threaded server; `$/cancelRequest` and `shutdown` do not help

labels.name: priority:p0
labels.description: Release blocker for v1 alpha production readiness

body:
### Area

Language server (`vize lsp --stdio`): responsiveness while Corsa is starting or answering a slow request

### Version

`vize` 0.432.0

### Minimal reproduction

`package.json` with `vue@3.5`, `typescript@5`; `tsconfig.json` with `strict`, `moduleResolution: "Bundler"`, including `src/**/*.ts` and `src/**/*.vue`.

`src/useToast.ts`

```ts
export function useToast() {
  return { show: (text: string) => text };
}
```

`src/App.vue`

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useToast } from "./useToast";

const { show } = useToast();
</script>

<template>
  <button @click="show('app')">App</button>
</template>
```

Client script:

1. `initialize`, `initialized`, `didOpen` `App.vue`.
2. Immediately send `textDocument/hover` on `useToast()` (this starts Corsa).
3. 200 ms later send `textDocument/documentSymbol` and `textDocument/foldingRange` together, then repeat them every second.

### Actual

```
hover (sent at open) done after 1686ms
t+200ms   documentSymbol=1486ms foldingRange=1486ms
t+2690ms  documentSymbol=2ms    foldingRange=3ms
t+3694ms  documentSymbol=3ms    foldingRange=3ms
```

`documentSymbol` and `foldingRange` need no type information (a few ms when idle), but they wait until the Corsa-backed hover finishes. In this tiny project that is ~1.5–2.6 s. In a real-world app with a few hundred SFCs:

- the same cheap requests waited ~58 s after opening a file;
- `references` took 12–56 s, and every other request (including documentHighlight, which is a pure text scan) queued behind it;
- after a client-side timeout and `$/cancelRequest`, queued requests still waited 21–28 s;
- `shutdown` timed out while a Corsa request was running, and the process ignored `exit` for 10 s;
- "corsa request outran 60000ms" was logged repeatedly.

### Expected

Syntax-only requests (symbols, folding, selection ranges, semantic tokens, formatting, lint diagnostics) answer immediately while Corsa is busy; `$/cancelRequest` drops queued / in-flight Corsa work; `shutdown` / `exit` are honoured promptly.

Related: #8008 is about type-backed requests themselves being slow; this issue is about everything else being blocked behind them.

### Likely cause

The server runs on a single-threaded executor (`crates/vize_maestro/src/runtime.rs`) and Corsa work is synchronous on it: `bridge.spawn()` never yields (`server/state/corsa.rs`), and editor-LSP calls `block_on` internally (e.g. `vize_canon/src/lsp_client/editor_lsp/code_actions.rs`). Moving Corsa calls to a blocking pool / separate task, or using a multi-threaded runtime, would let the other handlers run.

### Environment

- OS: macOS 26.4.1
- Architecture: arm64
- Node.js: 26.8.1
- Package manager: npm 11.19.0
- vue 3.5.x, typescript 5.9.3
